data.title: 黄泉 · 天亮之前
data.description: 清晨的微光透过窗帘，黄泉穿着长衫靠在床头，手边的薄毯还未收起。她安静地看着天色变亮。
data.promptProse: Resting against an ornate wooden headboard in a quiet hotel suite before dawn, Acheron pulls a coarse knit blanket across her lap as the very first cool lavender rays of sunrise seep through parted drapes. The shadowy room holds a silent, dreamlike stillness, with distant neon city lights fading into morning mist as she gazes into the awakening horizon with quiet, eternal sorrow.
data.animaCaption: She watches the first light through the curtains.
